messages:
alex: Heads up — we’re seeing a perf regression tied to CUDA 12.3+ driver on A100 long-seq workloads in staging. Latency climbs ~35-45% after ~10k tokens. Need quick partner coordination: pin marketplace images, request driver hotfix, and draft customer comms.

maria_s: Ugh. Do we have a simple repro and which images are impacted?

alex: Repro is a streaming chat loop with KV cache. Quick logs: ```\nkubectl logs runtime-pod | tail -n50\n... Kernel eviction warnings \nModel step latency +40% after 10k tokens\nPinned stack: cuda:12.3, driver:535.54, cuDNN:8.6\n```

kevin_h: Is ROCm affected or is this strictly CUDA/driver-side? Any visible difference on V100 vs A100?

alex: So far only A100+CUDA12.3 in staging. V100 lower seq workloads look fine. ROCm 5.6 runs clean in our quick smoke.

rachel_ops: Are Dedicated customers (reserved pools) impacted? If marketplace images are updated to 12.3 we should auto-pin to a safe tag until partner releases fix. Suggest: marketplace image -> redwood/base:cuda-12.2-pinned, keep 12.3 as canary only.

amend: (typo)

samir: I’ll open a joint ticket with NVIDIA + marketplace team now. Drafting partner note: ```\nSubject: Performance regression observed with CUDA 12.3 driver on A100\nHi — Redwood Inference observed a latency regression in CUDA 12.3 (driver 535.54) on A100 during long-sequence KV-cache workloads. Symptoms: increased token latency after ~10k tokens, kernel eviction logs. Can you confirm if any recent driver scheduler/kernel changes could explain this? Request: prioritise a driver hotfix or guidance on backcompat flags.\n```

samir: tagging marketplace and infra contacts in ticket, will paste link here when created.

alex: For immediate mitigation I recommend:
- Pin marketplace and official runtime images to cuda-12.2 for GA customers
- Expose a canary tag `redwood/runtime:cuda-12.3-canary` for opt-in testing
- Add runtime flag to force `--kernel-reclaim=off` (if vendor confirms safe)

maria_s: Agree. I'll create the image pin PR for marketplace. Kevin — can you add a CI smoke that runs 10k-token stream on canary images?

kevin_h: On it. I'll add a nightly long-seq smoke and a perf alert if median token latency > baseline +20%.

deploy-bot: AUTO-ROLLBACK: prod/rg-west detected degraded token latency; rolling back redwood/runtime:latest -> redwood/runtime:cuda-12.2-pinned on 3 nodes. (runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/runtime-perf)

rachel_ops: Thanks deploy-bot. Samir — please push partner ticket urgency to P1 and request ETA for hotfix. Also include a compatibility checklist (drivers, CUDA, cuDNN).

samir: Will do. Also proposing a joint announcement hold for marketplace image updates until fix validated.

alex: Action items: 1) samir: partner ticket + ETA (P1) 2) maria_s: marketplace pin PR + customer comm draft 3) kevin_h: nightly long-seq smoke + perf alert 4) rachel_ops: confirm Dedicated autoscale policy won’t reintroduce canary images.

maria_s: Draft customer note (short): "We are temporarily pinning runtime images to CUDA 12.2 due to a performance issue observed with CUDA 12.3 on some GPUs. No action required; we will notify when 12.3 is safe to opt into."

alex: Nice. Once NVIDIA responds we’ll coordinate a hotfix validation plan (staging -> canary -> prod) and a joint postmortem if needed.

kevin_h: FYI I'll capture perf traces (+nvprof / Nsight) and attach to the partner ticket.

rachel_ops: Good. If partner provides a driver hotpatch, we should request a signed build and validated driver manifest we can pin in marketplace.

samir: Ticket opened: https://tickets/redwood/PRJ-4521 — added logs and perf graphs. Marked P1 and requested vendor-signed hotfix.

alex: Thanks everyone. Keep updates in this thread and paste vendor replies. :white_check_mark:
